# 0001 Drip first

## Context and Problem Statement

A sprinkler line that opens before a drip line wastes water on a dry bed.

## Considered Options

- Open all lines together.
- Open the drip lines first.

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: open the drip lines first, because the drip lines wet the roots with the least water.

## Consequences

- Good: the beds get less water.
- Bad: the schedule takes more time.

## Status

The schedule script follows this decision.
